title: On Uniformly Perfect Morse Boundaries
summary: We introduce and geometrically characterize the notion of uniformly perfect Morse boundary for proper geodesic metric spaces. As a unifying result, we prove that the Morse boundary of any finitely generated, non-elementary group is uniformly perfect whenever it is nonempty. This theorem applies to a broad class of groups, including all acylindrically hyperbolic groups, Artin groups, and hierarchically hyperbolic groups.
